messages:
marta: deploy-bot flagged a mismatch between chart tag and values override for payments-eu overlay — image tag 2026.03.19 vs values.yaml 2026.03.18. Seeing post-canary alerts. can someone triage?
deploy-bot: :robot_face: Canary promotion paused: values.image.tag != chart.app.image.tag. Detection: overlay=payments-eu. Recommended action: pin values or rollback canary. see /deploy/3559876543
kevin: on it. which canary window/cluster?
sasha: EU-REG-1 canary. I saw a small spike in 5xx during traffic shift but not sure if image-related. logs show migration deprecation warnings.
raj: if it's an image mismatch we can either pin the chart to the old tag or do an image-only hotfix and promote. leaning hotfix if change is small.
kevin: checked release notes — the newer tag has a lib bump that changes connection pooling defaults. could explain latency/5xx.
oliver: we shouldn't roll forward until observability confirms. suggestion: hold canary, create image-only hotfix (revert lib bump) and promote that.
marta: agreed. what does deploy-bot do if we push hotfix with same chart version? will it auto-promote or require new canary?
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: If chart.version unchanged and values.image.tag updated in the release branch, the system treats it as a new promotion and will run the canary window. manual pin accepted via `/deploy pin <release>` to skip promotion.
kevin: i'll prepare an image-only tag 2026.03.19-hotfix and push values patch. plan to skip postupgrade hooks for safety: `--set postupgrade.enabled=false`.
kevin: ```helm -n payments-eu upgrade --install payments ./chart --reuse-values --set image.tag=2026.03.19-hotfix --wait --timeout 10m```
sasha: adding release note: "image-only hotfix to revert conn-pool bump, no DB migrations" — i'll add to release-notes.md
oliver: add canary watchlist: cpu, 5xx rate, p95 latency. keep canary window 15m.
raj: fallback plan: if hotfix triggers regressions, rollback to 2026.03.18 and pin chart version to avoid auto-promote. who's owner for rollback?
marta: kevin owns hotfix deploy, sasha monitors logs/alerts, raj on rollback path, i'll assemble release notes & postmortem if needed.
kevin: starting deploy now. ping to abort: @sasha @raj
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Promotion started for payments-eu canary. canary_id=canary-3559876543. monitor at /canary/3559876543
sasha: :eyes: watching. logs show no new 5xx yet.
sasha: 10m update: latency stable, 5xx=0, cpu +2%. looks ok so far.
raj: cutoff criteria: rollback if 5xx > 2% or latency > +30%. otherwise promote after full window.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary healthy window passed (15m). Auto-promotion queued. To block: `/deploy block canary-3559876543`
marta: :thumbsup: lets let it promote. kevin, confirm auto-promotion?
kevin: confirmed, proceed with promotion to prod overlay.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Promotion to prod initiated. post-action: generating release notes draft at /release/notes/3559876543
oliver: after promote, snapshot metrics and run smoke tests. I'll kick off the smoke run now.
sasha: updated release notes: "hotfix: revert conn-pool bump; no schema changes; patch promoted"
marta: closing thread — thanks team.
